events.verdict: Clarkson (UTA) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Mobley's (CLE) arm, which affects his SQBR with the ball in the post.
Niang (CLE) momentarily rests his forearm on Markkanen's (UTA) lower back and marginal contact occurs as he releases away from the defensive player during the rebounding opportunity.
Niang (CLE) raises his right arm up and makes legal contact with the ball, which deflects it away from Juzang (UTA) during the rebounding opportunity.
Niang (CLE) and Sexton (UTA) come together at the same spot on the floor while pursuing the loose ball and the contact is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Niang (CLE) makes last contact with the ball prior to it bouncing out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Utah.
LeVert (CLE) avoids making any illegal contact with Sexton (UTA) during his contest of the offensive player's driving shot attempt.
Niang (CLE) moves towards the basket as Sexton (UTA) releases his driving shot attempt and marginal contact occurs after Sexton releases the ball and is returning to the floor.
Sexton (UTA) extends his hand out and initiates contact with Mitchell's (CLE) right arm during the release, which affects Mitchell's jump shot attempt.
Niang (CLE) attempts to defend over the screen and marginal contact occurs as he comes together with Markkanen (UTA).
Mobley (CLE) legally contests Sexton's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Niang's (CLE) forearm comes out slightly as he pursues the loose ball and marginal contact occurs with Clarkson (UTA), who is going to the ground on his own accord, during the loose ball opportunity.
Markkanen (UTA) legally contests LeVert's (CLE) dunk attempt at the basket.

Replay review of the offensive foul called on Sexton (UTA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Sexton releases his pass and steps his right foot towards Niang (CLE) and moves into the defender's space, delivering contact that dislodges Niang as he moves to defend the dribble hand-off.
Clarkson (UTA) brings his right hand towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Mitchell's (CLE) side during his dribble into the frontcourt.
Markkanen (UTA) commits a take foul on LeVert (CLE).
LeVert (CLE) steps backwards away from the ballhandler as he moves to defend Markkanen (UTA) and marginal contact occurs as he and Markkanen come together off-ball.
Garland (CLE) extends his left hand out and makes contact with Juzang's (UTA) right forearm, which affects the release of his jump shot attempt.
